units.name: Enterprise Executive Strategy & Corporate Governance
units.description: Enterprise-level corporate strategy formulation, capital allocation, board governance, M&A due diligence, and enterprise transformation.
units.core_value_loop: Capital Allocation -> Strategic Horizon Scanning -> Governance & Gating -> Enterprise Transformation

units.name: Global Product Management & Customer Experience
units.description: Multi-product portfolio lifecycle management, technical product requirements, design systems, UX research, pricing, and growth monetization.
units.core_value_loop: Customer Need Discovery -> Platform Specification -> Ergonomic Design -> Monetization & Growth

units.name: Enterprise Cloud Infrastructure, SRE & Platforms
units.description: Multi-region cloud infrastructure, distributed microservices systems, site reliability engineering, CI/CD automation, and hybrid-cloud networks.
units.core_value_loop: Infrastructure Provisioning -> Automated Orchestration -> Continuous Reliability -> Cost & Capacity Optimization

units.name: Enterprise Data Lakehouse, Applied AI & MLOps
units.description: Modern data stack lakehouses, real-time stream processing, foundation model fine-tuning, vector database retrieval, and AI safety red-teaming.
units.core_value_loop: Data Ingestion & Contract -> Lakehouse Transformation -> Model Fine-Tuning -> Production Serving & Safety

units.name: Global Cybersecurity Operations & Threat Intelligence
units.description: 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC), incident command, red-team penetration testing, cryptographic engineering, and zero-trust identity.
units.core_value_loop: Threat Intelligence Ingestion -> Perimeter & Identity Defense -> Continuous Monitoring -> Incident Command & Eradication

units.name: Corporate Finance, Treasury, Tax & Internal Audit
units.description: Corporate controllership, SEC reporting (10-K/10-Q), strategic FP&A, liquidity treasury, international tax, and Sarbanes-Oxley audit.
units.core_value_loop: Financial Planning -> Transaction Accounting -> Capital Optimization -> Statutory Reporting & Internal Audit

units.name: Global Legal Counsel, Regulatory Compliance & Privacy
units.description: Corporate general counsel, commercial contracting, patent/IP portfolios, global data privacy (GDPR/CCPA), and antitrust defense.
units.core_value_loop: Regulatory Scanning -> Risk Policy Formulation -> Commercial Negotiation -> Compliance Auditing

units.name: Global Supply Chain Operations, Logistics & Procurement
units.description: Multi-modal global logistics, freight chartering, automated fulfillment centers, strategic supplier procurement, and reverse logistics.
units.core_value_loop: Demand Forecasting -> Sourcing & Procurement -> Multi-Modal Logistics -> Fulfillment & Reverse Logistics

units.name: Advanced Manufacturing & Plant Operations
units.description: Industrial plant manufacturing, Lean Six Sigma continuous improvement, PLC automation, SCADA controls, and predictive equipment maintenance.
units.core_value_loop: Production Scheduling -> Automated Fabrication -> Lean Quality Gating -> Maintenance Reliability

units.name: Enterprise B2B Commercial Sales, RevOps & Success
units.description: Enterprise software and service sales, revenue operations, deal desk negotiation, sales engineering, and customer onboarding.
units.core_value_loop: Pipeline Generation -> Solutions Architecture -> Deal Negotiation -> Customer Value Realization

units.name: Enterprise Human Resources & Talent Architecture
units.description: Executive talent acquisition, total rewards and equity compensation, people analytics, workforce planning, and employee relations.
units.core_value_loop: Talent Sourcing -> Compensation Structuring -> Organizational Development -> Retention & Culture

units.name: Clinical Trial Management & Bio-Regulatory Affairs
units.description: Phase I-IV clinical trial management, medical affairs, biostatistics, pharmacovigilance safety, and FDA/EMA electronic regulatory submissions.
units.core_value_loop: Protocol Design -> Clinical Execution -> Pharmacovigilance Monitoring -> Regulatory Approval

units.name: Energy Grid Operations & Decarbonization
units.description: Bulk electric grid transmission, renewable interconnection, battery energy storage dispatch, substation automation, and carbon offset tracking.
units.core_value_loop: Resource Planning -> Interconnection Modeling -> Real-Time Dispatch -> Grid Reliability & Decarbonization
